_comment: RED ON PURPOSE since plan_demo_steps@v11 (2026-08-20), for two independent reasons.
The regress harness ignores this key (fixtureSchema strips what it does not name).
(b) ACCEPTED COST — do not fix. The model reaches for הקמפיין (it is on state 11 as
'!הקמפיין נוצר') while captioning state 10, and the questionnaire only offers קמפיינים.
Prefix-stripping gets הקמפיין down to קמפיין, which is still not קמפיינים, so the
anti-fabrication rule rejects it. That is Hebrew plural morphology, not a bug: widening
wordVariants far enough to bridge it would let real invented claims through.
2026-09-15 (decision 0049): reason (b) no longer rejects anything — the provenance rule is a
highlight now, so הקמפיין would be MARKED on the step, not refused. (c) still stands.
(c) STALE TARGET. expected.sourceIndexes selects 5, 6 and 7, which sit 1500ms apart. The
read-time rule (added in 1ea1d94, AFTER this expectation was pinned) gives a step only the
gap to its next SELECTED state, and a three-word caption needs 1600ms — while the prompt's
floor is three words. Only states 5 and 6 are squeezed by this: 3 has 3500ms of room, 7 has
5000ms, 10 has 2500ms and 11 is last. So the pin is mechanically satisfiable (3/2/2/3/3/3
words totals exactly 11000ms and findPlanViolations passes it) but only by writing two-word
captions on 5 and 6, which the prompt forbids as field labels.
A plan obeying both drops one of the bunched pair. Beware the obvious replacement:
[3, 5, 7, 10, 11] runs 9600ms at three-word captions and 10800ms at four, both under the
band — it only lands inside with longer captions on the roomy steps. Re-pin only after a run
shows what the model reaches; do NOT relax the read-time rule to make this green.
2026-10-01 (decisions 0070/0072 — a step ends on a real screen change): recordingMs 20000 is
the DRY_RUN stub length this synthetic timeline was laid inside, not a measurement. Each step
now runs to its screen's end (one sample past the last state on it), at most 4s, and is cut by
the next selected state. The success state 11 sits 1500ms before the recording ends — under a
three-word caption's 1600ms — so it is no longer a required ending, and the canned plan
re-derives to [1, 3, 5, 8]. sourceIndexes (live) is untouched: still red for (c), and
unverified under plan_demo_steps@v15 until a paid regress.
2026-10-02 (fixed 2 s clips — decisions 0076, 0084, 0087): every step is its moment's 2 s
clip, a plan is 5-10 steps, and two steps never share footage, so the mechanical pin moved:
dryRunSourceIndexes [1, 3, 5, 8] -> [1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 11]. This fixture carries no footage
instants, so every clip starts at its moment and nothing is calm.
sourceIndexes (live) is untouched and unverified under plan_demo_steps@v16 until the paid
check re-takes it.
